user.description: Choose the model and behavior for the default assistant that shares this ChatGPT account. Authentication is completed in the next steps.

data_description.name: A friendly name for this conversation assistant.
data_description.model: The model used by this Assist conversation profile. The default profile's model is also used by AI Task actions and integration actions.
data_description.enable_home_assistant_control: Allow this assistant to inspect and control entities exposed to Assist. Disable this for conversation-only use.
data_description.enable_history_tools: Allows this assistant to answer questions about past states, trends, statistics, and Energy Dashboard data. It can only read data for entities exposed to Assist and cannot change or delete anything.
data_description.enable_ai_media_tools: Lets this assistant use ChatGPT OAuth AI Task to analyze text or exposed camera and image snapshots, and to create or edit images. Cameras are accessed only when you ask. Disabled by default.
data_description.selected_script_tools: Each selected script becomes one named, strongly typed tool. The assistant cannot choose another script or add undeclared fields. Script fields and selectors validate inputs, and the initiating user must have permission to control the script.
data_description.include_user_context: Shares only the initiating Home Assistant user's resolved display name with ChatGPT. Internal user IDs and other household members are never included. Disabled by default.
data_description.include_satellite_room_context: Shares the voice satellite, associated device, and current room as human-readable labels. Internal IDs, the configured home name, address, and coordinates are not sent. Disabled by default.
data_description.include_room_entities: Shares the names, types, and current states of up to 40 relevant entities in the current room. Only entities already exposed to Assist are included. Disabled by default.
data_description.max_tool_calls_per_turn: Stops new Home Assistant tool calls after this many calls in one message. Choose from 1 to 10.
data_description.max_total_tool_time: Stops Home Assistant tools when their combined execution time reaches this limit. Choose from 10 to 120 seconds.
data_description.memory_mode: Controls how much of the conversation is sent with each reply. Current message only starts fresh; Recent conversation keeps the latest turns; Recent conversation plus summary condenses older messages; Full conversation sends as much as fits the size limit.
data_description.memory_max_turns: Number of recent back-and-forth exchanges kept word for word. Used by Recent conversation and Recent conversation plus summary. One turn is one user message and the assistant's reply.
data_description.memory_max_characters: Approximate maximum number of conversation characters sent with each request. The current user message is always included. 16,000 characters is roughly 4,000 words.
data_description.web_search_mode: Disabled never exposes web search. Automatic lets the model search when useful. Required must return a web-search call or citation before the answer is accepted.
data_description.web_search_context_size: Low is best for simple lookups, Medium is balanced, and High provides more result context for detailed answers.
data_description.web_search_include_sources: Adds clickable source links and a Sources section when web search is used. Leave this off for cleaner voice responses; source details remain available in the response card and action metadata.
data_description.web_search_live_access: Allow OpenAI to fetch live pages. Disable this to use only cached or indexed search content when supported.
data_description.web_search_use_home_assistant_location: Shares Home Assistant's country and time zone with OpenAI web search. Exact coordinates and the configured home name are not sent unless precise location sharing is also enabled.
data_description.web_search_use_home_assistant_precise_lo: Shares Home Assistant's exact latitude, longitude, configured home name, country, and time zone with OpenAI when web search is used. Home Assistant does not provide a separate street-address field, but coordinates can identify your home. Disabled by default.
data_description.prompt_template_entities: Allows restricted states(), is_state(), and state_attr() lookups for only these selected entities. The initiating user must also have permission to read them. Other Home Assistant entities remain unavailable to the template.
data_description.prompt: Instructions used by this Assist conversation profile. Supports restricted Jinja variables including user_name, area_name, room_name, satellite_name, device_name, room_entities, local_time, and now(). User and room values remain empty unless their privacy settings are enabled.

reasoning.title: Thinking level
reasoning.description: Choose a thinking level available for **{model}**. Higher levels can improve difficult tasks but may respond more slowly. Ultra uses Max model reasoning because Codex subagent delegation is not available inside Home Assistant.

auth_manual.title: Sign in to ChatGPT
auth_manual.description:
1. Open [the ChatGPT sign-in page]({authorize_url}).
2. Complete sign-in in your browser.
3. The browser will finish on a localhost page that may show a connection error. Copy the **entire URL** from the address bar.
4. Paste that URL below.

The callback URL contains a short-lived authorization code. Do not share it.

data_description.callback_url: Paste the complete localhost callback URL from the browser address bar.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the ChatGPT service. Check the Home Assistant network connection and try again.
error.invalid_auth: ChatGPT rejected the sign-in or credentials. Start the sign-in step again.
error.invalid_response: ChatGPT returned an unsupported response during setup.
error.missing_code: Paste the complete callback URL or an authorization code.
error.rate_limited: The signed-in ChatGPT account is currently rate limited. Try again after its usage limit resets.
error.state_mismatch: The callback belongs to a different setup attempt. Restart setup and use the newly generated sign-in link.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred while setting up ChatGPT OAuth.
error.unsupported_model: Select one of the models shown in the list.
error.unsupported_model_or_web_search: Select a supported model and valid web-search settings.
error.unsupported_reasoning: Select a thinking level available for the chosen model.
